messages:
Maya (PM): quick thread  customers keep asking: BYOK for exports + defined export SLA (48h?) + retention presets. can we align on scope for a minimal ship?
Zane (Eng): tech note: BYOK for exports means we must wrap ephemeral export keys with customer KMS. we should avoid holding unencrypted exported bundles. retention presets are easy; legal_hold is the harder part.
Priya (Security): security must record who requested export, when, what key was used (kid), and a signed manifest. legal_hold should be append-only and require justification + ticket id. map to SOC2 evidence for log retention.
Nora (Ops): ops needs clear metrics: export queue size, estimate bytes/hour, and escalation for stuck exports. deploys touching retention must be gated until legal_hold is validated.
Liam (Legal): legal asks: export manifest must contain per-item hashes, timestamps, actor, and chain-of-custody statement. SLA: 48h reasonable for standard packages, expedited for legal holds. retention presets we propose: 90d / 1y / 7y / custom up to 10y.
Zane (Eng): proposed MVP scope:
- API: tenant retention PUT (preset selection)
- API: POST /exports that returns signed manifest + link to bundle when ready
- legal_hold flag persisted; retention job skips held tenants
No UI for M1. BYOK: provide envelope-encryption hooks but defer full BYOK self-service to M2.
Maya (PM): launch criteria for M1?
Priya (Security): 1) immutable audit trail for hold and export actions, 2) signed manifests for exported bundles, 3) KMS integration for wrapping ephemeral export keys (can be operator-driven for MVP), 4) tests proving retention job respects holds.
Nora (Ops): ops acceptance: runbook entries for stuck exports, hold detection, manual export path, and alerting thresholds.
Maya (PM): timeline suggestion: M1 in 6 sprints, M2 (self-serve BYOK + UI) in 12 sprints. tradeoffs?
Zane (Eng): tradeoffs: storage and index costs for long TTLs, complexity for per-tenant partitions, and potential performance hit during export. need a cost delta estimate.
Liam (Legal): we'll draft SLA language and manifest requirements.
deploy-bot: retention-job-v2 scheduled for 2026-03-15T02:00Z on branch retention/exports.
Nora (Ops): flagging hold  block that deploy until legal_hold audit passes.
Maya (PM): action items: Zane prototype schema + export flow by EOD Friday; Priya draft security checklist; Nora stub runbook; Liam draft SLA. I'll consolidate spec and circulate. Thanks. :+1:
